title: Gross = -SUM(LedgerAR IN); consultant = SUM of AP, EX and Misc ledger amounts on account types 6 and 8 (Reimbursable Consultant and Direct Consultant), year to date, per parent project
basis: Hypothesis: the export's Direct Consultant comes from consultant ledger entries, because the PR fee-ratio did not reproduce it (mixed direction, most PICs over 1%). Sign convention and account-type scope are assumptions to be tested.
